attackers_goals: Execute arbitrary code or run malicious applications undetected.
description: An Office process was executed with LOLBIN-like command-line arguments. This behavior is exhibited in the VBA-RunPE tool that executes executables from the memory of Word/Excel/PowerPoint.
investigative_actions: Check the file that spawns the office application and search for macros, formulas, or scripts.
name: Office process spawned with suspicious command-line arguments

variations.name: Masqueraded office process spawned with suspicious command-line arguments
variations.description: An executable masquerading an office process was executed with LOLBIN-like command-line arguments.
variations.attackers_goals: Execute arbitrary code or run malicious applications undetected.
variations.investigative_actions: Check the file that spawns the office application and search for macros, formulas, or scripts.

variations.name: PowerPoint process accesses a suspicious PPAM file
variations.description: A PowerPoint process opened a PPAM file which might be used to execute malicious code.
variations.attackers_goals: Execute arbitrary code or run malicious applications undetected.
